Moses (peace be upon him) and his companions proceeded until they crossed the sea. The family of Pharaoh then reached them. When they descended into the sea, they said to Pharaoh, "Are you not amazed by what you see?" He replied, "I have done this; so proceed and move through it." When Pharaoh and those with him reached the middle, Allah commanded the sea, and it closed in upon them, drowning them all. When the drowning overtook Pharaoh, he said, "I believe that there is no god except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims." Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says, "Now? And you had disobeyed before and were of the corrupters?" meaning, you were of the disobedient. "So today We will save you in your body..." It is said that the people of Pharaoh all perished in the sea, and none of them were seen again; they fell from the sea into the Fire. As for Pharaoh, Allah cast him out alone and threw him upon the shore so that they might look at him and recognize him, so that he might be a sign for those after him, and so that no one would doubt his destruction. They had taken him as a lord, so Allah showed him to them as a corpse cast upon the shore, to be a lesson and an admonition for those who came after him. Allah says, "And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless."
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 526
90.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 116; Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 315 (with the variation "they looked" instead of "they descended," and the omission of "Allah says... are heedless"); Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

90.ar: وَ دَخَلَ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) وَ أَصْحَابُهُ الْبَحْرَ وَ کَانَ أَصْحَابُهُ اثْنَیْ عَشَرَ سِبْطاً فَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ فِی الْبَحْرِ اثْنَیْ عَشَرَ طَرِیقاً فَأَخَذَ کُلُّ سِبْطٍ فِی طَرِیقٍ وَ کَانَ الْمَاءُ قَدِ ارْتَفَعَ عَلَی رُءُوسِهِمْ مِثْلَ الْجِبَالِ فَجَزِعَتِ الْفِرْقَةُ الَّتِی کَانَتْ مَعَ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) فِی طَرِیقِهِ فَقَالُوا یَا مُوسَی (علیه السلام) أَیْنَ إِخْوَانُنَا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مَعَکُمْ فِی الْبَحْرِ فَلَمْ یُصَدِّقُوهُ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَحْرَ فَصَارَتْ طَاقَاتٍ حَتَّی کَانَ یَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَی بَعْضٍ وَ یَتَحَدَّثُونَ وَ أَقْبَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَ جُنُودُهُ فَلَمَّا انْتَهَی إِلَی الْبَحْرِ قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ أَ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّی رَبُّکُمُ الْأَعْلَی قَدْ فُرِّجَ لِیَ الْبَحْرُ فَلَمْ یَجْسُرْ أَحَدٌ أَنْ یَدْخُلَ الْبَحْرَ وَ امْتَنَعَتِ الْخَیْلُ مِنْهُ لِهَوْلِ الْمَاءِ فَتَقَحَّمَ فِرْعَوْنُ حَتَّی جَاءَ إِلَی سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مُنَجِّمُهُ لَا تَدْخُلِ الْبَحْرَ وَ عَارِضْهُ فَلَمْ یَقْبَلْ مِنْهُ وَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَی فَرَسٍ حِصَانٍ فَامْتَنَعَ الْفَرَسُ أَنْ یَدْخُلَ الْمَاءَ فَعَطَفَ عَلَیْهِ جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) وَ هُوَ عَلَی مَادِیَانَةٍ فَتَقَدَّمَهُ وَ دَخَلَ فَنَظَرَ الْفَرَسُ إِلَی الرَّمَکَةِ فَطَلَبَهَا وَ دَخَلَ الْبَحْرَ وَ اقْتَحَمَ أَصْحَابُهُ خَلْفَهُ فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا کُلُّهُمْ حَتَّی کَانَ آخِرُ مَنْ دَخَلَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ وَ آخِرُ مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) أَمَرَ اللَّهُ الرِّیَاحَ فَضَرَبَتِ الْبَحْرَ بَعْضَهُ بِبَعْضٍ فَأَقْبَلَ الْمَاءُ یَقَعُ عَلَیْهِمْ مِثْلَ الْجِبَالِ فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ عِنْدَ ذَلِکَ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ فَأَخَذَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) کَفّاً مِنْ حَمْأَةٍ فَدَسَّهَا فِی فِیهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ.
90.fa: موسی (علیه السلام) و یارانش داخل رود نیل شدند و چون یاران او دوازده قبیله بودند، خداوند دوازده راه برای آن‌ها در نیل باز نمود و هر قبیله از راهی وارد نیل شدند. چون آب همچون کوه‌هایی بالای سرهایشان قرار گرفته بود آن قبیله‌ای که همراه موسی (علیه السلام) بودند، ابراز ناراحتی کرده و گفتند: «ای موسی! برادران ما چه شدند»؟ موسی (علیه السلام) گفت: «آن‌ها با شما در [حال عبور از] نیل هستند». ولی آن‌ها باور نکردند. به همین‌خاطر خداوند به نیل امر فرمود و دیوارهای آب، شفّاف شدند؛ به‌گونه‌ای که هر قبیله، دیگری را مشاهده می‌کرد و با یکدیگر سخن می‌گفتند. در همان حال، فرعون و سپاهیانش به کنار نیل رسیدند و فرعون به یارانش گفت: «آیا نمی‌دانید که من پروردگار برتر شما هستم؟ [ببینید که] دریا برای من شکافته شده است»! [امّا] کسی جرأت واردشدن به نیل را نداشت. اسب فرعون نیز از ترس آب، از راه رفتن باز ایستاد؛ ولی فرعون با سختی حرکت کرده و خود را به ساحل نیل رسانید. در این‌هنگام طالع‌بین فرعون به او گفت: «وارد نیل نشو و از این کار بگذر»! ولی فرعون قبول نکرد و سوار بر اسب نری شد؛ امّا این اسب هم از رفتن به داخل آب امتناع کرد. جبرئیل که سوار بر اسب مادّه‌ای بود، در جلوی اسب فرعون، وارد آب شد. اسبِ فرعون که نگاهش به اسب ماده افتاد به‌دنبال آن حرکت کرد و داخل نیل شد و یاران فرعون نیز به سختی پشت سر آن حرکت کردند. زمانی‌که همه‌ی آن‌ها وارد نیل شدند و آخرین نفر از آن‌ها همزمان با خروج آخرین نفر از یاران موسی (علیه السلام) وارد نیل گردید، خ-دا به بادها دس-تور وزیدن داد و آب‌ه-ا به ه-م متّ-صل شدند و همچون کوه‌هایی بر سر آن‌ها فرو ریختند. در این‌هنگام فرعون گفت: آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ المُسْلِمِینَ» ولی جبرئیل مشتی از گِل و لای برداشته و داخل دهان فرعون کرد و گفت: آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ المُفْسِدِینَ.
90.en: Moses (peace be upon him) and his companions entered the sea. Since his companions consisted of twelve tribes, God created twelve paths for them in the sea, and each tribe took a path. The water had risen above their heads like mountains, so the group that was with Moses (peace be upon him) on his path became anxious and said, "O Moses, where are our brothers?" He said to them, "They are with you in the sea." They did not believe him, so God commanded the sea, and it became like windows (or transparent partitions) so that they could see one another and speak to each other. Pharaoh and his soldiers arrived, and when he reached the sea, he said to his companions, "Do you not know that I am your Lord, the Most High? The sea has been parted for me." No one dared to enter the sea, and the horses refused because of the terror of the water. Pharaoh pushed forward until he reached the shore of the sea. His astrologer said to him, "Do not enter the sea; turn away from it," but he did not accept this. He approached on a stallion, but the horse refused to enter the water. Gabriel (peace be upon him) then approached him, riding a mare, and moved ahead of him into the water. The stallion saw the mare, pursued her, and entered the sea, and his companions followed him in. When they had all entered, and the last of his companions had entered just as the last of the companions of Moses (peace be upon him) had exited, God commanded the winds, and they struck the sea, crashing one part against another. The water began to fall upon them like mountains. At that moment, Pharaoh said, "I believe that there is no god except the One in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims." Gabriel (peace be upon him) then took a handful of mud and stuffed it into his mouth, then said, "Now? While you had disobeyed before and were of the corrupters?"
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 528
90.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 122; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 121; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Jaza'iri, p. 238 (with slight variations in wording).

90.ar: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِیمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِی قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا (علیه السلام) لِأَیِّ عِلَّةٍ أَغْرَقَ اللَّهُ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ قَدْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَ أَقَرَّ بِتَوْحِیدِهِ قَالَ لِأَنَّهُ آمَنَ عِنْدَ رُؤْیَةِ الْبَأْسِ وَ الْإِیمَانُ عِنْدَ رُؤْیَةِ الْبَأْسِ غَیْرُ مَقْبُولٍ وَ ذَلِکَ حُکْمُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی ذِکْرُهُ فِی السَّلَفِ وَ الْخَلَفِ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنا قالُوا آمَنَّا بِاللهِ وَحْدَهُ وَ کَفَرْنا بِما کُنَّا بِهِ مُشْرِکِینَ فَلَمْ یَکُ یَنْفَعُهُمْ إِیمانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنا وَ قَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَوْمَ یَأْتِی بَعْضُ آیاتِ رَبِّکَ لا یَنْفَعُ نَفْساً إِیمانُها لَمْ تَکُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ کَسَبَتْ فِی إِیمانِها خَیْراً وَ هَکَذَا فِرْعَوْنُ لَمَّا أَدْرَکَهُ الْغَرَقُ قَالَ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ فَقِیلَ لَهُ آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ لِتَکُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَکَ آیَةً وَ قَدْ کَانَ فِرْعَوْنُ مِنْ قَرْنِهِ إِلَی قَدَمِهِ فِی الْحَدِیدِ قَدْ لَبِسَهُ عَلَی بَدَنِهِ فَلَمَّا غَرِقَ أَلْقَاهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی عَلَی نَجْوَةٍ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ بِبَدَنِهِ لِیَکُونَ لِمَنْ بَعْدَهُ عَلَامَةً فَیَرَوْنَهُ مَعَ تَثَقُّلِهِ بِالْحَدِیدِ عَلَی مُرْتَفِعٍ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَ سَبِیلُ الثَّقِیلِ أَنْ یَرْسُبَ وَ لَا یَرْتَفِعَ فَکَانَ ذَلِکَ آیَةً وَ عَلَامَةً وَ لِعِلَّةٍ أُخْرَی أَغْرَقَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ هِیَ أَنَّهُ اسْتَغَاثَ بِمُوسَی (علیه السلام) لَمَّا أَدْرَکَهُ الْغَرَقُ وَ لَمْ یَسْتَغِثْ بِاللَّهِ فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ إِلَیْهِ یَا مُوسَی (علیه السلام) لَمْ تُغِثْ فِرْعَوْنَ لِأَنَّکَ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهُ وَ لَوِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِی لَأَغَثْتُهُ.
90.en: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani said: I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him), "For what reason did Allah drown Pharaoh, even though he believed in Him and acknowledged His oneness?" He replied, "Because he believed only when he saw the punishment, and faith at the sight of punishment is not accepted. This is the decree of Allah, whose mention is exalted, regarding those of the past and those to come. Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said: 'So when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in Allah alone and we disbelieve in what we used to associate with Him." But their faith could not benefit them when they saw Our punishment' (Ghafir: 84-85). And He, the Almighty and Majestic, said: 'The day that some of the signs of your Lord come, no soul will benefit from its faith if it had not believed before or had earned through its faith some good' (Al-An'am: 158). Likewise, when the drowning overtook Pharaoh, he said: 'I believe that there is no god except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims.' It was said to him: 'Now? And you had disobeyed before and were of the corrupters? So today We will save you in your body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign' (Yunus: 91-92). Pharaoh was covered in iron from head to toe, which he wore upon his body. When he drowned, Allah, the Exalted, cast his body upon a high place of the earth so that it would be a sign for those after him, and they would see him—despite the heaviness of the iron—upon a high place of the earth. The nature of a heavy object is to sink and not to rise; thus, this was a sign and a mark. There is another reason why Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, drowned him: when the drowning overtook him, he sought help from Musa (peace be upon him) and did not seek help from Allah. So Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed to him: 'O Musa! You did not aid Pharaoh because you did not create him; had he sought help from Me, I would have aided him.'"
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 530
90.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 130; 'Ilal al-Sharai', Vol. 1, p. 59; 'Uyun Akhbar al-Rida, Vol. 2, p. 77; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Jaza'iri, p. 239; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

90.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِی عُمَیْر قُلْتُ لِمُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) أَخْبِرْنِی عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لِمُوسَی (علیه السلام) اذْهَبا إِلی فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغی فَقُولا لَهُ قَوْلًا لَیِّناً لَعَلَّهُ یَتَذَکَّرُ أَوْ یَخْشی فَقَالَ أَمَّا قَوْلُهُ فَقُولا لَهُ قَوْلًا لَیِّناً أَیْ کَنِّیَاهُ وَ قُولَا لَهُ یَا أَبَامُصْعَبٍ وَ کَانَ اسْمُ فِرْعَوْنَ أَبَامُصْعَبٍ الْوَلِیدَبْنَ مُصْعَبٍ وَ أَمَّا قَوْلُهُ لَعَلَّهُ یَتَذَکَّرُ أَوْ یَخْشی فَإِنَّمَا قَالَ لِیَکُونَ أَحْرَصَ لِمُوسَی (علیه السلام) عَلَی الذَّهَاب وَ قَدْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ أَنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَا یَتَذَکَّرُ وَ لَا یَخْشَی إِلَّا عِنْدَ رُؤْیَةِ الْبَأْسِ أَ لَا تَسْمَعُ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَقُولُ حَتَّی إِذا أَدْرَکَهُ الْغَرَقُ قالَ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ فَلَمْ یَقْبَلِ اللَّهُ إِیمَانَهُ وَ قَالَ آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ.
90.en: Ibn Abi Umayr said: I said to Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him), "Inform me about the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, to Musa (peace be upon him): 'Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed. But speak to him with gentle speech, that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah].' (Ta-Ha: 43-44)" He replied, "As for His words, 'speak to him with gentle speech,' it means to address him by his kunya (patronymic) and say to him, 'O Abu Mus’ab,' for the name of Pharaoh was Abu Mus’ab al-Walid ibn Mus’ab. And as for His words, 'that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah],' Allah only said this to make Musa (peace be upon him) more eager to go, even though Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, knew that Pharaoh would neither be reminded nor fear [Allah] until he witnessed the punishment. Do you not hear Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, saying: 'Until, when the drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims." But Allah did not accept his faith and said, "Now? And you had disobeyed before and were of the corrupters?"' (Yunus: 90-91)."
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 530
90.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 134; ‘Ilal al-Shara’i’, Vol. 1, p. 67; Qisas al-Anbiya’ by al-Jaza’iri, p. 245 (in which the phrase "and the name of Pharaoh was Abu Mus’ab" is omitted); al-Burhan.

90.ar: عَنْ سُفْیَانَ بْنِ سَعِید یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) هَلْ یَجُوزُ أَنْ یُطْمِعَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عِبَادَهُ فِی کَوْنِ مَا لَا یَکُونُ قَالَ لَا فَقُلْتُ فَکَیْفَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لِمُوسَی وَ هَارُونَ (علیها السلام) لَعَلَّهُ یَتَذَکَّرُ أَوْ یَخْشی وَ قَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَا یَتَذَکَّرُ وَ لَا یَخْشَی فَقَالَ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ قَدْ تَذَکَّرَ وَ خَشِیَ وَ لَکِنْ عِنْدَ رُؤْیَةِ الْبَأْسِ حَیْثُ لَمْ یَنْفَعْهُ الْإِیمَانُ أَ لَا تَسْمَعُ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَقُولُ حَتَّی إِذا أَدْرَکَهُ الْغَرَقُ قالَ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ فَلَمْ یَقْبَلِ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ إِیمَانَهُ وَ قَالَ آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ لِتَکُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَکَ آیَةً.
90.en: Sufyan ibn Sa'id said: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), "O son of the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family)! Is it permissible for Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, to give His servants hope for something that will not come to pass?" He replied, "No." I said, "Then how did Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, say to Moses and Aaron (peace be upon them), 'Perhaps he may remember or fear' (Ta Ha/44), when He knew that he (Pharaoh) would neither remember nor fear?" He replied, "Pharaoh did indeed remember and fear, but it was at the moment of witnessing the divine wrath, at a time when faith would no longer benefit him. Have you not heard Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, saying: 'Until, when the drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no god except He in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims."' Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, did not accept his faith and said: 'Now? And you had disobeyed before and were of the corrupters? So today We will save you in your body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign.'"
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 532
90.refs: Ma'ani al-Akhbar, p. 385; al-Burhan; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 135

90.ar: مَا أَتَی جَبْرَئِیلُ رسول الله إِلَّا کَئِیباً حَزِیناً وَ لَمْ یَزَلْ کَذَلِکَ مُنْذُ أَهْلَکَ اللَّهُ فِرْعَوْنَ فَلَمَّا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِنُزُولِ هَذِهِ الْآیَةِ آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ نَزَلَ عَلَیْهِ وَ هُوَ ضَاحِکٌ مُسْتَبْشِرٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ رسول الله (صلی الله علیه و آله) مَا أَتَیْتَنِی یَا جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) إِلَّا وَ تَبَیَّنَتِ الْحُزْنُ فِی وَجْهِکَ حَتَّی السَّاعَةِ قَالَ نَعَمْ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لَمَّا غَرَّقَ اللَّهُ فِرْعَوْنَ قالَ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ فَأَخَذْتُ حَمْأَةً فَوَضَعْتُهَا فِی فِیهِ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَهُ آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ وَ عَمِلْتُ ذَلِکَ مِنْ غَیْرِ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ خِفْتُ أَنْ یَلْحَقَهُ الرَّحْمَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَ یُعَذِّبَنِی عَلَی مَا فَعَلْتُ فَلَمَّا کَانَ الْآنَ وَ أَمَرَنِی اللَّهُ أَنْ أُؤَدِّیَ إِلَیْکَ مَا قُلْتُهُ أَنَا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَمِنْتُ وَ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ ذَلِکَ کَانَ لِلَّهِ رِضًا قَوْلُهُ فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ فَإِنَّ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) أَخْبَرَ بَنِی إِسْرَائِیلَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ غَرَّقَ فِرْعَوْنَ فَلَمْ یُصَدِّقُوهُ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَحْرَ فَلَفَظَ بِهِ عَلَی سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ حَتَّی رَأَوْهُ مَیِّتاً.
90.en: Gabriel (peace be upon him) never came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) except that he was sorrowful and sad, and he remained so ever since Allah destroyed Pharaoh. But when Allah commanded the revelation of this verse: "What! Now! And indeed you disobeyed before and were of the corrupters," he descended upon him smiling and joyful. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him, "O Gabriel, you have never come to me but that I saw sadness on your face until this moment." He replied, "Yes, O Muhammad. When Allah drowned Pharaoh, he said: 'I believe that there is no god except He in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims.' I took a handful of mud and placed it in his mouth, then said to him: 'What! Now! And indeed you disobeyed before and were of the corrupters.' I did that without a command from Allah, and I feared that Allah’s mercy might reach him and that He would punish me for what I had done. But now that Allah has commanded me to convey to you what I had said to Pharaoh, I have become secure and realized that it was in accordance with Allah’s pleasure." Regarding His saying: "So today We will save you in your body," Moses (peace be upon him) had informed the Children of Israel that Allah had drowned Pharaoh, but they did not believe him. So Allah commanded the sea, and it cast him onto the shore so that they saw him dead.
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 532
90.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 117; Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 316 (with the omission of "His saying: So today... they saw him dead"); Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Jaza'iri, p. 239

90.ar: إِنَّ جَبْرَئِیلَ (علیه السلام) قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله): لَوْ رَأَیْتَنِی وَ فِرْعَوْنَ یَدْعُو بِکَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ وَ أَنَا دَفَنْتُهُ فِی الْمَاءِ وَ الطِّینِ لِشِدَّةِ غَضَبِی عَلَیْهِ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ یَتُوبَ فَیَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ. قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله): وَ مَا کَانَ شِدَّةُ غَضَبِکَ عَلَیْهِ یَا جَبْرَائِیلُ؟ قَالَ: لِقَوْلِهِ أَنَا رَبُّکُمُ الْأَعْلَی وَ هِیَ الْکَلِمَةُ الْآخِرَةُ مِنْهُ وَ إِنَّمَا قَالَ حِینَ انْتَهَی إِلَی الْبَحْرِ، وَ کَلِمَةُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَکُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَیْرِی فَکَانَ بَیْنَ الْأُولَی وَ الْآخِرَةِ أَرْبَعِینَ سَنَةً وَ إِنَّمَا قَالَ ذَلِکَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَنَا رَبُّکُمُ الْأَعْلَی حِینَ انْتَهَی إِلَی الْبَحْرِ فَرَآهُ قَدْ یَبِسَ فِیهِ الطَّرِیقُ فَقَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ: تَرَوْنَ الْبَحْرَ قَدْ یَبِسَ مِنْ فَرْقِی فَصَدَّقُوهُ لَمَّا رَأَوْا ذَلِکَ، فَذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ وَ أَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُ وَ مَا هَدَی.
90.en: Gabriel (peace be upon him) said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): "If you had seen me when Pharaoh uttered the word of sincerity, saying: 'I believe that there is no god except He in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims,' I buried him in the water and mud due to the intensity of my anger toward him, fearing that he might repent and that Allah would accept his repentance." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: "And what caused your intense anger toward him, O Gabriel?" He replied: "Because of his saying, 'I am your exalted Lord' (Naziat/24), which was his final statement when he reached the sea, and his other statement, 'I do not know that you have any god other than me' (Qasas/38). There were forty years between the first and the last statement. He only said 'I am your exalted Lord' to his people when he reached the sea and saw that the path had dried up within it. He said to his people: 'Do you see the sea? It has dried up out of fear of me.' When they saw that, they believed him. That is the meaning of His saying: 'And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide them' (Taha/79)."
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 532

90.ar: عن الْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ قُلْت لسَیِّدِیَ الصّادق (علیه السلام) ... یَا سَیِّدِی وَ مَوْلَایَ وَ الدِّینُ الَّذِی فِی آبَائِهِ إِبْرَاهِیمَ وَ نُوحٍ وَ مُوسَی وَ عِیسَی وَ مُحَمَّدٍ (هُوَ الْإِسْلَامُ قَالَ نَعَمْ یَا مُفَضَّلُ هُوَ الْإِسْلَامُ لَا غَیْرُ قُلْتُ یَا مَوْلَایَ أَ تَجِدُهُ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِ إِلَی آخِرِهِ وَ مِنْهُ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ إِنَّ الدِّینَ عِنْدَ اللهِ الْإِسْلامُ وَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی مِلَّةَ أَبِیکُمْ إِبْراهِیمَ هُوَ سَمَّاکُمُ الْمُسْلِمِینَ وَ مِنْهُ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی فِی قِصَّةِ إِبْرَاهِیمَ وَ إِسْمَاعِیلَ (علیها السلام) وَ اجْعَلْنا مُسْلِمَیْنِ لَکَ وَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّتِنا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَکَ وَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی فِی قِصَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ حَتَّی إِذا أَدْرَکَهُ الْغَرَقُ قالَ آمَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا الَّذِی آمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوا إِسْرائِیلَ وَ أَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ وَ فِی قِصَّةِ سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) وَ بِلْقِیسَ قَبْلَ أَنْ یَأْتُونِی مُسْلِمِینَ وَ قَوْلِهَا أَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَیْمانَ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِین.
90.en: Mufaddal ibn Umar narrated: I said to my master, al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), "O my master and patron, is the religion held by his [the Imam of the Time's] forefathers—Abraham, Noah, Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad—Islam?" He replied, "Yes, O Mufaddal, it is Islam, and nothing else." I asked, "O my master, do you find this in the Book of Allah?" He said, "Yes, from its beginning to its end. Among these [evidences] is the verse: 'Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam' (3:19). And His saying, the Exalted: 'The religion of your father, Abraham. He named you "Muslims"' (22:78). And among them is His saying, the Exalted, in the story of Abraham and Ishmael (peace be upon them): 'And make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You' (2:128). And His saying, the Exalted, in the story of Pharaoh: 'Until, when the drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims"' (10:90). And in the story of Solomon (peace be upon him) and Bilqis: 'And come to me as Muslims [in submission to Allah]' (27:31), and her statement: 'I have submitted with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds' (27:44)."
90.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 534

91.ar: یقول الله آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِینَ یقول کنت من العاصین.
91.fa: اینکه خدا می‌فرماید: آلْآنَ وَ قَدْ عَصَیْتَ قَبْلُ وَ کُنْتَ مِنَ الْمفْسِدِینَ؛ یعنی [ای فرعون! تو] از گناهکاران بودی!
91.en: Regarding the words of Allah, "Now? And you had disobeyed before and were of the corrupters," He says: You were among the sinners.
91.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 534

92.ar: قَوْلُه فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ فَإِنَّ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) أَخْبَرَ بَنِی إِسْرَائِیلَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ غَرَّقَ فِرْعَوْنَ فَلَمْ یُصَدِّقُوهُ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَحْرَ فَلَفَظَ بِهِ عَلَی سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ حَتَّی رَأَوْهُ مَیِّتاً.
92.fa: [در توضیح سخن خداوند فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ] موسی (علیه السلام) به بنی‌اسرائیل خبر داد که خداوند فرعون را غرق کرده است؛ امّا آن‌ها باور نکردند. پس خداوند به دریا امر کرد که جنازه‌ی او را به ساحل بیاورد تا بنی‌اسرائیل او را مرده ببینند.
92.en: Regarding His saying, "So today We will save you in your body," Musa (peace be upon him) informed the Children of Israel that Allah had drowned Pharaoh, but they did not believe him. So Allah commanded the sea, and it cast him out onto the seashore so that they might see him dead.
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 534
92.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 118 / Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 316 / Nur al-Thaqalayn

92.ar: إِنَّ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ذَهَبُوا أَجْمَعِینَ فِی الْبَحْرِ فَلَمْ یُرَ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ هَوَوْا فِی الْبَحْرِ إِلَی النَّارِ وَ أَمَّا فِرْعَوْنُ فَنَبَذَهُ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ فَأَلْقَاهُ بِالسَّاحِلِ لِیَنْظُرُوا إِلَیْهِ وَ لِیَعْرِفُوهُ لِیَکُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَهُ آیَةً وَ لِئَلَّا یَشُکَّ أَحَدٌ فِی هَلَاکِهِ وَ إِنَّهُمْ کَانُوا اتَّخَذُوهُ رَبّاً فَأَرَاهُمُ اللَّهُ إِیَّاهُ جِیفَةً مُلْقَاةً بِالسَّاحِلِ لِیَکُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَهُ عِبْرَةً وَ عِظَةً یَقُولُ اللَّهُ وَ إِنَّ کَثِیراً مِنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ آیاتِنا لَغافِلُون.
92.fa: همراهان فرعون همگی وارد آب دریا شده [و در دریا غرق گشتند] و هیچ اثری از آن‌ها باقی نماند سپس جسم همه‌ی آن‌ها [مستقیماً] وارد آتش شد؛ مگر جسد فرعون که خداوند تنها جنازه‌ی او را به ساحل انداخت تا مردم او را ببینند و بشناسند تا نشانه‌ای برای آیندگان باشد و اَحَدی نسبت به مرگ او شک نکند زیرا آن‌ها او را به‌عنوان خدای خود می‌شناختند. لذا خداوند او را به صورت لاشه‌ای که به ساحل افتاده بود، به آن‌ها نشان داد تا مایه‌ی عبرت و پند آیندگان باشد. وَ إِنَّ کَثیراً مِنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ آیاتِنا لَغافِلُونَ.
92.en: Pharaoh’s people all went into the sea and not one of them was seen again; they plunged into the sea and then into the Fire. As for Pharaoh, Allah cast him out alone and threw him upon the shore so that they might look at him and recognize him, so that he would be a sign for those who came after him, and so that no one would doubt his destruction. For they had taken him as a lord, so Allah showed him to them as a carcass cast upon the shore, to be a lesson and an admonition for those who come after him. Allah says: "And indeed, many among the people are, of Our signs, heedless."
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 536
92.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 117 / Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 316

92.ar: کَانَ عَلَی مُقَدِّمَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ ستمائة ألف و مائتی ألف {سِتُّمِائَةِ أَلْفِ أَلْفٍ وَ مِائَتَا أَلْفٍ} وَ عَلَی سَاقَتِهِ أَلْفُ أَلْفٍ فدخلوا البحر و غرقوا و قوله فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ لِتَکُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَکَ آیَةً یقول نلقیک علی نجوة من الأرض لتکون لمن بعدک علامة و عبرة.
92.fa: در جلو لشکر فرعون ششصدهزار نفر بودند و دویست‌هزار نفر در روبرو و یک‌میلیون نفر در دو جانب سپاه او بودند که همگی وارد دریا شده و غرق گشتند. و این کلام خداوند که می‌فرماید: فَالْیَوْمَ نُنَجِّیکَ بِبَدَنِکَ لِتَکُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَکَ آیَةً می‌گوید که [ای فرعون]! جسد تو را به روی بلندی‌ای از زمین می‌اندازیم تا برای آیندگان تو نشانه و پند باشد.
92.en: At the vanguard of Pharaoh’s army were six hundred thousand and two hundred thousand [800,000], and at his rear were one million. They entered the sea and drowned. Regarding His saying: "So today We will save you in your body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign," it means: We will cast you upon a high place of the earth so that you may be a sign and a lesson for those who come after you.
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 536

93.ar: فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ قَالَ رَدُّهُمْ إِلَی مِصْرَ وَ غَرَقُ فِرْعَوْنَ.
93.fa: [منظور از عبارت]: مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ آن است که بنی‌اسرائیل را به مصر برگرداند و فرعون غرق شد.
93.en: Regarding the saying of the Almighty, "a settled abode of truth" (mubawwa'a sidq), he said: "It means returning them to Egypt and the drowning of Pharaoh."
93.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 536
93.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 106; Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 316; and Al-Burhan
